title: Hoodit v1 read-tool contracts
description: Amended 2026-09-17 contract for seven read-only Hoodit v1 tools using Blockscout inventory continuations and bounded optional valuation.

x-tools.name: hoodit_search_tokens
x-tools.description: Find Robinhood-chain token candidates by name, symbol, or exact address; never resolves an ambiguous symbol into a trading instruction.

x-tools.name: hoodit_discover_pools
x-tools.description: Browse GeckoTerminal-indexed trending, new, high-volume, or active Robinhood pools. New pools do not necessarily mean newly launched tokens.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_token
x-tools.description: Inspect an exact Robinhood ERC-20: token mark, capitalization, volume, selected-pool liquidity/activity, and optional metadata. Not an executable quote.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_candles
x-tools.description: Get single-pool USD OHLCV for an exact token with explicit interval and historical cutoff. Returns source pool and coverage; not wallet performance.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_trades
x-tools.description: Inspect recent public pool trades, oriented to the requested token. Free-provider window: at most the latest 300 trades in 24 hours; not personal trade history.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_portfolio
x-tools.description: Read one wallet inventory page and optionally value its holdings with LI.FI sample sell quotes into USDG. Includes native ETH on page one; no cost basis or P&L.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_holding
x-tools.description: Read an exact wallet holding and compute an integer-sized fraction for a possible sale. Optionally quote that fraction into USDG; 10000 bps quotes the whole holding. Does not stage or trade.

Address.description: EVM input address. Output addresses are normalized to lowercase.

TokenId.description: The literal native, or an ERC-20 contract. Never a symbol or a pool ID.

PoolId.description: Opaque GeckoTerminal pool identifier; may be a 32-byte v4 ID, not necessarily a contract address. URL-encode as one path segment.

Decimal.description: Non-negative decimal string, no exponent. Units are specified by the field.

SignedDecimal.description: Signed decimal string. Percentage fields use percentage points: 12.5 means +12.5%, not 0.125.

Atomic.description: Unsigned integer token base units; additionally enforce <= uint256 max.

scope.description: wallet only for a complete initial page with successful native read; otherwise page.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation bound to this chain, wallet, fixed ERC-20 filter, and bounded hop count. Omit this field entirely for the first page; do not send JSON null, an empty string, or the string 'null'. For later pages, reuse only the exact next_cursor returned for the same wallet.

InventoryPagination.description: One Blockscout ERC-20 provider page. The continuation is opaque, stateless, versioned, and bound to chain, wallet, filter, and hop count.

returned.description: Valid nonzero ERC-20 rows; native ETH is not counted.
